summary: BikePOS MVP end-to-end validated. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering root, POST/GET/LIST/DELETE (soft) with Create->GET persistence, 404s, and MongoDB _id exclusion. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): PIN flow (wrong pin shakes/clears, 8193 unlocks -> home), coded calculator (YVK->1.350.000, YP->1.000.000, YF->1.200.000, QZ->9.900.000 confirming Z repeats), backspace + Hapus working, Check Harga Jual reveals margin input, +250rb chip gives 1.600.000, View Harga Ke Pembeli shows only price and tap dismisses, Barang Terjual opens Sales Form prefilled and Simpan navigates to Riwayat, sale appears in list and delete (soft) removes it revealing 'Belum ada penjualan' empty state. All specified testIDs render correctly.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 for creation (per template convention). Non-blocking.
Uses deprecated Pydantic v1 .dict() and FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'). Consider .model_dump() and lifespan handler.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported... falling back to JS-based animation.' This is expected on web preview only; on native it will use native driver. No action needed for web.
Deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (likely from react-native-keyboard-controller or phosphor icons on web). Non-blocking on web; monitor upstream.

action_items: (Optional) Consider returning 201 on POST /api/sales for REST semantics.
(Optional) Migrate from Pydantic v1 .dict() to .model_dump() and FastAPI on_event to lifespan handler.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly excludes MongoDB _id in responses via dict-comprehension filter.

All frontend interactive elements have testIDs as promised (pin-key-*, key-*, check-harga-jual-button, margin-chip-250000, view-buyer-price-button, barang-terjual-button, save-sale-button, sales-list, delete-sale-<id>).
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly through /app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts (via useSales/useCreateSale/useDeleteSale hooks).
PIN is hardcoded client-side (documented). Acceptable for shop-owner lock per PRD.
seed_data_creation: Test sales created during pytest are all soft-deleted in cleanup. One additional playwright-created sale ('TEST_PW_Sepeda' / 'TEST_PW_Andi') was created and then deleted through UI as part of the delete flow test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows currently work. Backend endpoints: POST/GET/GET-by-id/DELETE /api/sales all functional; soft-delete via deleted_at works and 404s properly. Frontend Expo web preview loads on mobile viewport. testIDs are complete and stable. Two harmless web-only console warnings (useNativeDriver, pointerEvents) can be ignored on web preview.
rca_of_issue: N/A - MVP passes all specified checks.
